lines: In Mosaic, emotions live as people. Rain, who carries
Sadness, thinks a tear has spoiled a paper festival moth.
Nova, who carries Wonder, sees something worth keeping.

lines: Rain: “I made the wing too wet.”
blocks.text: Rain: “I made the wing too wet.”

lines: Nova: “Let me see what the water does.”

lines: Beam brings Happiness to the festival. Fizz organizes the
lights, Bloom makes room for others, and small, vulnerable
Puff gets a real task instead of being carried out of the way.
blocks.text: Beam brings Happiness to the festival. Fizz organizes the lights, Bloom makes room for others, and small, vulnerable Puff gets a real task instead of being carried out of the way.

lines: Bloom: “Hold the shade there, Puff. We need your
hands.”

lines: Anger is not always destructive: Flare uses heat to free a
stubborn hinge. Quiver checks the danger, and Mend
anchors a safety line. The three work better together than
alone.
blocks.text: Anger is not always destructive: Flare uses heat to free a stubborn hinge. Quiver checks the danger, and Mend anchors a safety line. The three work better together than alone.

lines: Quiver: “A little more. The hinge is moving.”
blocks.text: Quiver: “A little more. The hinge is moving.”

lines: Flare: “Then a little is enough.”
Bitter, Disgust, notices a white coating that does not
belong on the festival lamps. Pop stops before touching it.
Quest, Curiosity, recognizes that someone has altered the
city’s equipment.

lines: Bitter: “That film was not here this morning.”
blocks.text: Bitter: “That film was not here this morning.”

lines: Quest: “Then someone has been working on our lamps.”
blocks.text: Quest: “Then someone has been working on our lamps.”

lines: Still looks after the city’s voluntary quiet rooms. Hope, a
lantern apprentice, prepares a moth for Nova. Choosing
quiet does not make either of them an enemy of feeling.
blocks.text: Still looks after the city’s voluntary quiet rooms. Hope, a lantern apprentice, prepares a moth for Nova. Choosing quiet does not make either of them an enemy of feeling.

lines: Hope: “Nova taught me this fold.”
Still: “You can give it to her after the procession.”
blocks.text: Still: “You can give it to her after the procession.”

lines: Beam supplies light, Rain supplies droplets, and Nova
divides the softened glow through a prism. Three paths
appear where one harsh beam would have fallen. Their
different gifts make the result possible.
blocks.text: Beam supplies light, Rain supplies droplets, and Nova divides the softened glow through a prism. Three paths appear where one harsh beam would have fallen. Their different gifts make the result possible.

lines: Nova: “Keep the water, Rain. It gives the light
somewhere to spread.”
blocks.text: Nova: “Keep the water, Rain. It gives the light somewhere to spread.”

lines: A white service barge slips into the festival canal. Its hood is
collecting light instead of giving it back. Rain and Nova have
noticed the intruder, but they do not yet know its target.

lines: Rain: “Why are the lanterns dimming behind that boat?”
